decisions.reason: As a recent, adjacent laser-marking extension that was still listed in 2024, it likely costs little to maintain and its niche demand has probably not been observed long enough to justify abandonment.

Its dedicated product-page presence in both 2023 and 2024 suggests continuing commercial relevance, and for a growing, R&D-active coding specialist this close-to-core printer remains a valuable option to serve different applications.
Because it stayed on its own page across both years and fits the firm's core high-resolution coding portfolio, management would keep the option open while market learning continues.
A 2024 launch featured on the home page indicates strategic importance and very early-stage uncertainty, so a large expanding firm would continue backing it rather than exit immediately.

This newly launched laser cabin had a dedicated launch presence in 2024 and extends the established laser offer, making it sensible to retain while demand and cross-selling potential are still unfolding.
The product won a trade-fair award and addresses a specialized industrial application close to the firm's capabilities, so the upside remains credible and there is no strong signal yet to abandon it.
